header.name: Verdant Bot 1.2.8 • Bedrock 1.21.114 • Autonomous Survival Hardened
header.description: 1.2.8 SURVIVAL HARDENING: fixes the stuck/escape/loop defects. Lava-aware A* (soft cost on cells touching lava, never stepping into lava), HP-aware fall drops (healthy bot plans 4-5 block drops with damage pricing, hurt bots don't), best-effort partial routes at >=2 blocks progress, FIFO tie-break in the open heap. Escape overhaul: the 12-tick suicide watchdog is gone (walk-outs now give 80 stagnant ticks, re-arming on movement), any survivable escape is ranked-and-taken (not refused because it doesn't point at the owner), diagonals probed, immediate water-bucket lava clutch, shared pure rankEscapePlans() with regression tests. Global unstuck watchdog: 60s no position/inventory progress -> force fresh approach; 120s -> honest blocked-task instead of an infinite loop. Arbiter ordering fixed: fall=100 head-water=99 escape=97/94 always outranks food=90 and missions. Waypoint radius 0.72. See docs/BOTTLENECKS.md for the full audit. Keeps 1.2.7: director mining via assignMine, iron-tier nether prep gate, bucket/flint_steel/shield/bread recipes, gravel/obsidian/#logs mineable; keeps 1.2.4 BRAIN layer, A* 1200 nodes/r24, rolling-horizon partial routes. 74 modules.
